legal_name: TRIDENT SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not verified against MCA)
note: NOT VERIFIED - no registry record obtained. Research attempts failed technically, not evidentially: DuckDuckGo/searx backend refused connections (2 calls), Google returned only a redirect interstitial, Bing returned only generic 'Trident' brand results (tridentcare.com, trident.co, Wikipedia) with no Indian company-registry hit for 'TRIDENT SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED' in West Bengal, and the direct registry/profile pages were inaccessible - zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, instafinancials.com returned HTTP 404, tofler.in returned its 404 page, quickcompany.in timed out. Consequently CIN/LLPIN, PAN (and therefore the 4th-character holder type), GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all null: they are not public to me in this session, not absent from the registry. Registered state is therefore NOT confirmed as West Bengal - the claimed state is unverified. Role is 'unknown' rather than manufacturer/trader because no MCA business-object or GST activity record was read; the declared HS codes 382762 and 870899 (chemical preparations / motor-vehicle parts) are inconsistent with a company named 'Services' and with the claimed 'oil & gas and chemicals' industry, but per project rules an HS mismatch is not a rejection ground and no HS verdict is issued here. Revenue FY25 and FY26 are null - no audited accounts or official filing was accessible, and no figure is estimated. IMPORTANT: this is NOT a rejection. Per the rules, rejection requires positive proof that the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt; no such proof was found, so the company must be treated as pending verification and re-queued for a registry lookup (MCA master data / GST public search) rather than rejected. No shipment, court or catalogue research was performed, per role scope.
